name: A mbira cycle
about: Composed for this atlas in the manner of the mbira dzavadzimu music of the Shona: a cycle of forty-eight pulses in four phrases, each phrase a broken chord falling through the keys, the harmony moving by step as the old pieces do, to be repeated and varied for as long as a ceremony lasts; a second mbira interlocks with it a pulse behind. Mbira tunings vary from instrument to instrument; these are the nearest notes.
